tafari anthony.bio: Toronto singer-songwriter and producer Tafari Anthony is a Canadian R&B and pop artist whose Juno-nominated work centers queer identity, emotional honesty and a wide vocal range.

tamia.bio: Windsor-born singer-songwriter Tamia is a Canadian R&B and soul artist whose Grammy-nominated career includes enduring hits such as So Into You, Stranger in My House and Spend My Life with You.

tasha rozez.bio: Toronto DJ Tasha Rozez is a Canadian reggae and dancehall selector and soundsystem figure known as Gunz'n'Rozez and recognized as a pioneering woman in sound-clash culture.

tedy.bio: Haiti-born, Montréal-rooted singer-songwriter Tedy is a Canadian pop artist whose emotionally vulnerable songs grew from an early YouTube following into a Sony Music Canada recording career.

the della kit.bio: Vancouver producer, vocalist, DJ and educator the della kit, born Dee Landsberg, is a Canadian R&B, soul and jazz artist whose work combines live musicianship, experimental production and sound-healing practice.

the foundation.bio: Montréal collective The Foundation is a Canadian genre-blending ensemble led by Fredy V and Mel Pacifico, combining funk, R&B, Afrobeats and hip-hop with a rotating cast of musicians and producers.
